projectDescription: Decompiled C# source code of the RimWorld colony simulation game, organized by namespace, serving as a reference for mod developers.
keyFeatures: Full decompiled C# source across all RimWorld namespaces (Verse, RimWorld, RimWorld.Planet, Verse.AI, RimWorld.QuestGen, RimWorld.BaseGen, Verse.Grammar, Verse.Sound)
Core Pawn class with 30+ tracker components (health, needs, skills, jobs, AI, apparel, equipment)
XML-driven Def system for data-driven game content (ThingDef, HediffDef, RecipeDef, BiomeDef, etc.)
ThingComp component system allowing modular behavior composition on any ThingWithComps
AI system with JobDrivers, ThinkNodes, and LordJob behavior trees for pawn decision-making
Quest scripting system (QuestGen) with composable QuestNodes and Slate variable system
Procedural map generation with GenSteps and BaseGen SymbolResolvers
World layer (RimWorld.Planet) with caravans, settlements, faction goodwill, and orbital trade
publicApiSurface: Verse.Thing — Base class for all in-game objects
Verse.Pawn — Character class with full tracker component hierarchy
Verse.Def / Verse.DefDatabase<T> — Data definition registry system
Verse.Map — Tile grid containing all things, rooms, terrain, and pawns
RimWorld.Faction — Faction with goodwill relations and leader tracking
Verse.AI.JobDriver — Base class for all pawn job behaviors
Verse.AI.ThinkNode — AI behavior tree node base class
RimWorld.IncidentWorker — Base class for all random events and raids
RimWorld.QuestGen.QuestNode — Composable quest script node base class
RimWorld.Planet.World — World grid, factions, settlements, and caravan management
RimWorld.Planet.Caravan — Traveling group of pawns on the world map
Verse.HediffWithComps / Verse.HediffComp — Health condition component system
Verse.RecipeDef / Verse.RecipeWorker — Crafting and surgery recipe system
RimWorld.BaseGen.SymbolResolver — Procedural map content generation resolver
